entries.en: Ask {name} about your open worksheets. It can read them, check their errors, and propose edits for you to review.
Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
{name} has not changed any worksheets in this conversation. Each worksheet is backed up before its first change.
{name} was not found. Install it ({hint}), or set the path to its executable.
Not found. Install it ({hint}) or enter the full path to its executable.
Plan mode: {name} can read and plan, but not change anything.
Review the diff to accept or reject it.
No output on this channel yet.
The document as written — #pre and #post both shown, entered #UI values ignored
The print layout — #pre hidden, entered #UI values applied
The source listing, with macros and includes resolved
Write the entered values into the document so they survive a reload
Apply edits to open worksheets without review; no commands or file writes
Ask before running commands or editing
Explore and propose a plan without making changes
Export the report — #pre hidden, entered #UI values applied — as a PDF
'.NET date/time format string, e.g. M/d/yyyy h:mm tt'
Nothing writes until you press Write to Disk.
Only a report render writes: the preview pane switched to Report, and a report export. The Preview view leaves the files alone, so typing does not rewrite them.
Read and propose a plan; no edits, commands or file writes
Show "Page n of m" in the footer
Show the report the entered values produce
Show the timestamp in the header
The Preview and Report views both write, so the files are rewritten as you type. The input form does not.
Work without asking, changing only open worksheets; every change is backed up
Export report to PDF and open (Ctrl+E)
Export report to Word and open
Download every plot as a single ZIP archive
Download this plot as an image file
No plots in the current document.
Re-run the current document and list its plots
Run this document now and write its #write/#append files to disk
Save this document and everything it references as a ZIP that runs anywhere
Save this document as a compiled .cpdz worksheet
Save this document's {variant} as a PDF
Save this document's {variant} as a Word .docx file
Save this document's {variant} as standalone HTML
Another program changed this file while you had unsaved edits. Choose which version to keep.
Discard your edits and load the file from disk
Keep your edits; saving will overwrite the file on disk
Save each version as a copy next to the file
Also the header title of PDF exports, unless the Title PDF setting hides it. Set to the file name on first save.
Apply to save {n} change, Reset to revert changes | Apply to save {n} changes, Reset to revert changes
File info is added to the last line the first time this file is saved.
No user name is set, so saves and reviews won't record who made them.
Auto-indents the active document. Content is not modified outside of whitespace.
Parameters fill the § placeholders in the inserted text, in order.
Star an item to pin it here.
Type ~ then the letters and a space to insert this item.
Accept any expression, written to the document verbatim. Turns 'Keep the unit' off.
Off puts the unit in the control instead of leaving it in the document.
Pixels, or a percentage of the line such as 75%. Natural width when empty.
Place the cursor on a line to edit its properties.
This #UI directive contains invalid JSON. Applying will replace it with the values below.
Header/footer separator line color as a hex code, default #b3b3b3
A hotkey needs Ctrl, Alt or {meta}, or a function key
Adds a line per request, on both the server and the editor. Useful when diagnosing a specific worksheet, noisy otherwise, since editing sends requests continuously.
Adds one-off events: startup, the bound URL, server restarts, shutdown, and browser downloads.
A document declaring #UI controls opens as its input form the first time you open it.

A worksheet that renders to more HTML than this is not shown in the preview — showing it risks running the app out of memory. Exporting to PDF, HTML or DOCX is unaffected. Raise it only if you need very large documents on screen.

Calculate #post blocks while the input form is shown, hidden, so their variables stay available to later lines. Turn off to skip them entirely and keep the form responsive when the report is all at the end.
Concentrates sample points where the curve bends sharply instead of spacing them evenly. Produces smoother plots of curved functions at a lower point count; disable for a fixed dense sampling.
Ctrl+B for bold, Ctrl+I for italic, etc.
Display very small matrix/vector values as 0 instead of using scientific notation.
Failures plus recoverable problems, such as a missing browser for PDF export. The default, and silent during normal editing.
For #UI lines in this file excluding loops, macros, and includes: a value entered in the input form is written into the #UI line, and editing the value on that line removes its saved override.
Height of the plot area in pixels (at least 1). Can be overridden per-document with a PlotHeight = … line.
How long to wait before showing code suggestions while typing. Zero shows them immediately.

How many console lines one preview render may relay before the rest are dropped. A worksheet whose scripts log in a loop can otherwise flood the console channel. Raise it when debugging a script, lower it when a library is noisy. Each line is clipped to 4 KB regardless.
Ignore #hide so suppressed content is rendered anyway. For debugging.
JuliaMono is the bundled default. Drop .woff2/.woff/.ttf/.otf files into the fonts folder to make them available here.
Lines retained in each Output channel before older lines are dropped. Lower values reduce memory use and improve responsiveness when logs are noisy.
Maximum number of rows/columns shown for large matrices and vectors (5–100).
Mesh size for map (surface) plotting in pixels; 0 lets Calcpad choose automatically. Can be overridden per-document with a PlotStep = … line.
Only failures. Crash and hang reports are always written regardless of this setting.
Opens the folder containing server logs and the most recent crash dump.
Open the folder where custom fonts can be dropped. Reopen the Font Family picker to pick up new fonts.
Preview and Report show the PDF export itself, with its exact pages, headers, and footers. Slower than the HTML preview.
Preview normally shows the document's own values. Turn this on to render it with the values entered into the input form instead, for tracking down an error that only appears once a form is filled in.
Professional (checked) renders equations in stacked math form; Inline (unchecked) renders them on a single line.
Recorded in a file's info (Info tab) as its author, who last updated it, and who reviewed it.
Relative precision for numerical methods such as integration and root finding (1e-15 to 1e-2). Can be overridden per-document with a Precision = … line.
Renders plots as SVG (scalable, sharp at any zoom) instead of raster PNG images.
Scroll the preview to follow the line the cursor is on in the editor.
Selects US or UK definitions for bare unit names that differ between the two systems (gal, ton, cwt, pt, qt, bbl, tonf, therm, etc.).
Set a hotkey to open this setting
Set a hotkey to toggle this setting
Show saved #UI values above the lines they apply to: the value for a lone #UI control, a count for loops, macro calls and #include lines. Click one to edit it in the Properties tab.
Show the file info and saved #UI values comments at the end of the file. They are hidden by default and edited in the Properties tab.
Star a setting to pin it here.
Target tolerance for the iterative PCG solver and eigensolver (1e-15 to 1e-2). Can be overridden per-document with a Tol = … line.
The hotkey turns this setting on and off.
When off, the preview only re-renders when it is first opened or a manual run is triggered.
Width of the plot area in pixels (at least 1). Can be overridden per-document with a PlotWidth = … line.
No headings found. Add headings to your document using
Includes values from #include lines and macro calls in the selection.
No saved #UI values. Values entered into the input form are saved here, at the end of the file.
No values for the selected lines.
Place the cursor on a line to see its values.
Reverts displayed #UI overrides back to their default values.
Values entered into the input form. Click a name to go to the #UI line that declares it.
Write #UI overrides into the CalcpadCE file as defaults and remove the override. Values in loops, macros, and includes are unaffected.
No variables found. Open a CalcpadCE document to see variables, macros, and functions.
Search variables, macros, functions, custom units...

dynamic.sourceLine: <button @click="$emit('savePdf', group.variant)" :title="t('Save this document\'s {variant} as a PDF', { variant: t(group.label).toLowerCase() })">{{ t('Save PDF…') }}</button>
<option v-for="s in pdfKeys" :key="s.key" :value="s.key" :title="s.detail ? tt(s.detail) : undefined">{{ tt(s.label) }}</option>
<option v-for="s in pdfKeys" :key="s.key" :value="s.key" :title="s.detail ? tt(s.detail) : undefined">{{ tt(s.label) }}</option>
<option v-for="opt in LOCALE_OPTIONS" :key="opt.value" :value="opt.value">{{ opt.translatable ? tt(opt.label) : opt.label }}</option>
